positions.title: Graduate School & Projects
positions.description:
• Founded a company (Whisper Analytics) and granted support from AWS's Activate accelerator to develop and gather insights from an automotive dataset useful for insurance pricing models, using an ETL pipeline (PySpark, AWS Lambda, Postgres)
• Design and implemented DocuCloud, a backend Java/Spring Boot cloud filesystem w/ REST API that models a file tree hierarchically in Postgres and performs distributed transactions across the database and AWS S3
• Significantly reduced AWS S3 storage requirements by ~30% via a de-duplication algorithm that created soft links to identical files

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated on a fast-paced team to bootstrap a supplements e-commerce sales platform by shipping features bi-weekly, contributing to sprint planning and participating in code reviews
• Facilitated a 70% revenue increase by engineering fulfillment and inventory management systems (SAP) to handle a 90% YOY increase in order volume
• Collaborated with DevOps engineers to establish a robust testing environment, enabling the deployment of a CI/CD pipeline that reduced the change failure rate by 33% while improving release velocity.
• Created a Java backend for a management portal incorporating OAuth2 authentication, allowing role-based privileges for internal users via Keycloak & Spring Security
• Migrated an SAP / Amazon.com integration from a polling to notification-based architecture (AWS SNS + SQS), which improving failure handling and reduced out-of-stock events by 20%
• Enabled a 60% Op-Ex reduction by integrating systems from a recently acquired company, transitioning from Oracle Fusion to SAP and migrating OLAP & OTP SQL databases
positions.insights: Skills: Object Oriented Design · Redis · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Design Patterns · Back-End Web Development · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Cloud Computing · Agile Development · Computer Science · Cloud Applications · Databases

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with product manager and multiple technical stakeholders to launch and continuously develop features for a data analytics portal and data pipeline.
•	Developed a pipeline (Python, Apache Airflow) to reshape and clean an unstructured dataset, allowing it to be repurposed for a new initiative, saving weeks of work for a stakeholder team.
•	Improved query performance by 60x for a database synchronization with AWS Redshift by using read cursors to avoid multiple table scans, allowing a new feature to be added without impacting existing users.

projects.title: DocuCloud
projects.description:
•	Backend REST API for a cloud filesystem that allows file versioning through copy on write – similar to Google Drive.
•	Overcame difficult challenge of modeling hierarchical directory structure in Postgres using the Ltree module and trigger functions to enforce filesystem invariants.
•	Significantly reduced S3 storage requirements by implementing a data de-duplication algorithm that created symbolic links to identical files in the database avoiding duplication on S3
•	Avoided high memory usage of multiple concurrent file transfers using buffered streams that reduced memory requirements per request to a constant maximum, independent of file size
•	Implemented distributed transactions across S3 and Postgres which were thoroughly integration tested using Postgres and MinIO (S3 surrogate) TestContainers.

Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, AWS S3, TestContainers, ProjectReactor, jOOQ, Postgres, JUnit, Mockito
